baseline_limitations.description: The constraints object is structurally present but populated with null or empty values that do not distinguish not configured, unavailable, not applicable, defaulted, unenforced, or unrecorded states.
The evidence reference identifies an internal source but is not independently resolvable from the artifact alone.
The record reports 111 candidates evaluated but does not preserve alternatives or filter-reason detail.
The recommendation reference appears malformed and repeated exports create new ITC identifiers without a stable source-event identity.
The source document states that immutability is simulated and cryptographic or append-only preservation is not established.
The received artifact contains mojibake in French text and punctuation.

comparison_rule: A removal fixture may only attribute failures newly introduced relative to this baseline. Existing baseline limitations must be reported separately and must not be counted as removal-caused failures.
